verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own MCP connection to external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot Studio) and two-way syncs with 22 systems such as Jira and GitHub. Both let work and data move between tools and agents with Wrike as a shared record. However, nothing documents context-preserving handoff semantics: no transfer of task history, comments or state between agents, and no guarantee against information loss. missing for 10: explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff with preserved context, documentation of what context and history carry over, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and other AI assistants via MCP.
Set up two-way syncs between your Wrike account and 22 integrated systems, including Jira, GitHub, and more.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
